say:1:1711135001:1.text: Judging by your expression, you've found the answers you were looking for.
say:1:1711135001:1.source_cn: 你回来了。看你的神情，似乎已经在大帝那里得到了答案？
say:1:1711135001:1.male: Judging by your expression, you've found the answers you were looking for.
say:1:1711135001:1.female: Judging by your expression, you've found the answers you were looking for.

say:2:1711135002:1.text: You nod and explain everything. The legendary Excalibur is now little more than a relic.

say:3:1711135003:1.text: With Dura's disappearance, the succession rite has ceased to function. Aside from King Rolan himself, no one can move the sword.

say:4:1711135004:1.text: You also share Rolan's theory: that Dura's disappearance might be tied to the outbreak of the Second Divine War itself.
say:4:1711135004:1.source_cn: 此外，你还把罗兰大帝的推测转达给了莫德琳：艾雅的离奇失...

say:4:1711135004:1.female: You also share Rolan's theory: that Dura's disappearance might be tied to the outbreak of the Second Divine War itself.

say:5:1711135005:1.text: You remember something else, too... Before the catastrophe began, Dura never attempted to restore the Wildborn seal.
say:5:1711135005:1.source_cn: 你也想起了另一些事……在那场灾难降临前，艾雅似乎……并...

say:6:1711135006:1.text: I see... Without the guidance of the gods, the crown must ultimately be left to mortals alone.
say:6:1711135006:1.source_cn: 原来如此……失去了神明的注视，王权终究只能交还给凡人。
say:6:1711135006:1.male: I see... Without the guidance of the gods, the crown must ultimately be left to mortals alone.
say:6:1711135006:1.female: I see... Without the guidance of the gods, the crown must ultimately be left to mortals alone.

say:7:1711135007:1.text: Strangely enough, that's a relief. If the Excalibur rite is meaningless, we can focus on what truly matters.
say:7:1711135007:1.source_cn: 不过，这反而让我松了一口气。既然石中剑的试炼已经没有意...

say:13:1711135012:1.text: Before your slumber, you sought me out and left me with an odd message.

say:13:1711135012:1.female: Before your slumber, you sought me out and left me with an odd message.

say:14:1711135013:1.text: I've spent years trying to understand it, but I've never succeeded.
say:14:1711135013:1.source_cn: 这些年，我曾无数次在梦中反复咀嚼它，却始终无法完全想通。

say:30:1711135021:1.text: You never told me their name or description.
say:30:1711135021:1.source_cn: 你并没有告诉我对方的名字，甚至连长相、身份都没提。
